ghi_chu: Muoi O NHAN: 2 tieu de tab (generateMetadata) + 8 nhan thanh ben. Dem O NHAN chu khong dem chuoi. Muc thanh ben thu tam la Truong, them ngay 18/09 boi ho so truong-tu-tao-o-cai-dat. Tu 04/10 so_o 10 -> 18 va them khoi thanh_ben: db5641ba6 (21/09) doi danh sach muc thanh ben sang apps/app/lib/cai-dat-dieu-huong.ts, bfb313301 (25/09) chia bon nhom co nhan rieng (nhomThanhBen), cac luot sau them Giai doan, To chuc, Chuong trinh OKR, Dieu phoi — 12 nhan muc + 4 nhan nhom + 2 tieu de tab. Khoa nam o khoa_tai, tra cuu kho chuoi o tra_cuu_tai; object co thuoc tinh nhom_khi_co la nhan NHOM.
